g.text: Update to Arduino R3 shield type
Populate with 2x3 female connector to be compatible with Leonardo/Mega
Added solder jumper to select between GBUF and GND
Line Out to Speakers or Amplifier
GPIO0 low / GPIO1 high puts VS1053 in MIDI mode

Default configuration: solder blob between top and middle pads for DC-coupled output to headphones or passive speakers. Desolder default and add solder blob between middle and bottom pads for AC-coupled line output.
Moved LED to 3.3V rail to load regulator
Changed all 0402 footprints to 0603 for easier optical inspection
GPIO0 low / GPIO1 low puts VS1053 in MP3 mode
Reworked the v1.4 DC-blocking circuit, made it selectable via jumpers SJ3, SJ4, SJ5.
Moved to tighter SOIC FP on HEX inverter
RST now pulled low by default
